faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Quick answers about WoW Forever access and purchases.

items.question: Do I need to buy Forever if I already subscribe to WoW?
items.answer: The base game is included with an active WoW subscription or game time. Buy a pack only if you want Skyborne, included beta access, or other extras.

items.question: Does signing up guarantee beta access?
items.answer: No. The official sign-up offers a chance to participate. Epic Pack and Collection list Beta Access as a pack benefit.

items.question: Does Heroic Pack include beta access?
items.answer: No. Heroic includes Skyborne, its starting experience, and early name reservation, but the official comparison does not list Beta Access.

items.question: Is the mainland China launch date confirmed?
items.answer: No verifiable mainland schedule is available. The English official page and Taiwan store dates do not establish a mainland server date.

home.confusionTitle: Where players are most likely to overspend or misread access

facts.title: The base game is not a separate purchase
facts.body: Base Forever play is included with an active WoW subscription or game time. You do not need a pack merely to own the base version.

facts.title: Signing up does not guarantee an invite
facts.body: The official sign-up offers a chance to test. The lowest pack that explicitly includes Beta Access is Skyborne Epic Pack.

facts.title: Skyborne requires a pack
facts.body: Skyborne and its Zephras Isle start require Heroic Pack or higher. A subscription alone covers base access.

home.returningTitle: Think of Forever as another long-running WoW line
home.returningBody: It begins from the foundations of WoW's first era, but it is not a simple re-release. Official descriptions include expanded zones, 1,000+ new quests, new dungeons, class and specialization reworks, Legacy progression, and system changes.

dates.timezoneTitle: Why can the date differ by one day?
dates.timezoneBody: A global event may happen at one moment while stores convert it to a local calendar day. Without a published hour and time zone, a countdown creates false precision.

about.title: About
about.intro: Forever Guide is an unofficial rules and decision tool for players returning to WoW for Forever.

sections.title: How we handle information
sections.body: We use official public pages as the baseline, keep regional schedules separate, and show the last verification date. We do not present leaks or speculation as confirmed facts.

sections.title: What this site does not do
items: Collect Battle.net account, character, or payment information
Sell packs, test access, or activation codes
Claim an official relationship with Blizzard Entertainment
Treat another region's dates as a mainland China schedule

privacy-policy.title: Privacy policy
privacy-policy.intro: This site is designed to work without collecting personal account information.

sections.title: Local storage
sections.body: Theme, cookie consent, and checklist choices may be stored in your browser. They are not sent to this site.

sections.title: Analytics and advertising
sections.body: Google Analytics and advertising services load only after consent when the site operator has enabled them. These providers may process device or usage data under their own policies.

sections.title: External links
sections.body: Official game, store, and support links are operated by Blizzard or other third parties. Their privacy policies apply after you leave this site.

terms-of-service.title: Terms of service
terms-of-service.intro: This site provides unofficial reference information, not a purchase, testing, or server promise from Blizzard.

sections.title: Accuracy
sections.body: Schedules, pack benefits, and test status can change. Check the official page again before a purchase or account action.

sections.title: External sites
sections.body: This site links to official game and store pages but does not control their content, availability, or transactions.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
sections.body: You are responsible for decisions to purchase, subscribe, or join a test. The site operator is not responsible for purchases, account issues, or in-game losses resulting from reliance on this guide.
